a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan (operate until 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is safe. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. Please don't also take 4: a random split would likely leave us both with 2 and both dead. After I take, I'll operate with you every round so the reserve refills for you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen mine yet. I'm sorry for breaking the agreement. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator adds 2 cells per round, and you can take 4 as soon as the reserve has 4. I won't take any more.
